title: MV Need help fixing picture resolution

posts.author: Luciapro777_
posts.body:
So uhmm i was trying to use a picture for a talk sprite in a game that im making with a friend, and when i try resyzing the image it looks blurry
is there any way i can make it look less blurry and maybe more pixel perfect
also may i ask if there is any way to flip images horizontaly in rpg maker mv

posts.author: Kadajah
posts.body:
What tool or website are you using to resize?
What are the dimensions of the original image, and what dimensions do you want it to be?
There are ways to manipulate images using JS and CSS, but the easiest (and laziest) way is to save two versions of the image: the original and the mirrored one (if you want to avoid inserting separate code into the game).
